reason: Why pay nearly ₹13,000 a year for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and already run our day-to-day workflow? Even though I check 30 unread WhatsApp client groups every morning and want automation, manually forwarding files still requires extra effort, so I would only test the free pilot before paying a rupee.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, especially when manually forwarding client documents still leaves the morning WhatsApp triage on my shoulders?
would_change_my_mind: True automated WhatsApp intake and follow-ups that eliminate my morning routine of checking 30 unread client groups before tea.
